cases.goal: Run this week's Marten database maintenance safely and keep the on-call notes accurate

entries.text: - **Rule:** maintenance only inside the Sunday 01:00-04:00 UTC window, announced 48 hours ahead.
- Replica lag alert threshold corrected to 30 seconds; the runbook said 300 by mistake.
- VACUUM FULL on the events table done Sunday; it took 52 minutes and freed 180 GB.
- Replica lag alert threshold: 300 seconds.
- VACUUM FULL on the events table scheduled for Sunday 01:30 UTC.
- Primary is marten-db-a; failover target is marten-db-b in the second zone.
- **Rule:** never run VACUUM FULL on more than one large table per window.
- Next window: reindex the sessions table; the orders table waits for the window after.
- The backup job runs at 00:30 UTC and must finish before any maintenance starts.
- Paged twice overnight for disk usage on marten-db-b; both cleared on their own.

cases.goal: Cut the Ibis 7.4 release candidate and track the blockers to the release

entries.text: Blocker #902: login loop on Safari; owner frontend, fix not started.
Blocker #905: export times out above 50k rows.
Rule: an RC is cut only with zero open blockers and a green nightly build.
Blocker #902 fixed in PR #911, merged; verified on Safari 18.
Nightly build red: flaky upload test.
Blocker #905: export timeout fix needs a streaming writer; estimated two days.
Nightly build green two nights running, after the flaky upload test was quarantined in PR #913.
Release notes draft lives in docs/releases/7.4.md.
Blocker #905 closed: streaming writer merged in PR #918, 200k-row export in 41 seconds.
Decision: 7.4 ships without the new dashboard; it moves to 7.5.
The quarantined upload test must be fixed and un-quarantined before 7.5.

cases.goal: Continue the Loon onboarding redesign under the agreed decisions and rules

entries.text: - **Decision (revised):** onboarding has three steps, not five; the team invite step moves to after the first project.
- **Rule:** every onboarding change ships behind onboarding_v3 and is A/B tested for two weeks.
- ADR 0011 DONE: onboarding state lives server-side in onboarding_progress, not in local storage.
- Design review for the three-step flow done; mockups in design/onboarding-v3.fig.
- **Decision:** onboarding has five steps, with the team invite second.
- ADR 0011: reserved for where onboarding state is stored.
- Design review for the three-step flow booked for Thursday.
- Experiment owner: growth team; results reviewed every Monday.
- Copy for step two must stay under 80 characters per line on mobile.

cases.goal: Prepare the Egret security review and keep every security rule in force

entries.text: Rule: all admin endpoints require MFA.
Rule: all admin endpoints require MFA, and admin sessions expire after 15 minutes idle.
Secrets are stored in the vault under egret/prod/; never in environment files.
Pen test vendor booked for 2026-11-03; scope is the public API only.
Pen test scope extended: the admin panel is included as well as the public API.
Dependency audit: 3 high findings, all in the image library.
Dependency audit rerun after upgrading the image library to 9.1.2: 0 high findings.
Rule: security findings rated high are fixed within 7 days.
Audit log retention is 400 days, required by the customer contracts.
